verdict.rationale: Event webhooks are a reasonable thing to ask of a coding agent that runs as a server, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The headless `opencode serve` HTTP/OpenAPI server and the JS/TS SDK are inbound control surfaces and developer building blocks, not webhook subscriptions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
